chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl, from Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl, from Abū al-Ṣabbāḥ, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a slave who falsely accused a free man, and he said: “He is to be flogged eighty lashes.”

key_terms.افْتَرَى: falsely accused or fabricated a claim against someone
key_terms.ثَمَانِينَ: eighty; the number of lashes prescribed
key_terms.حُرٍّ: a free man; the one against whom the accusation was made
key_terms.عَبْدٍ: a slave; the person committing the false accusation in this ruling
key_terms.يُجْلَدُ: he is to be flogged; the prescribed corporal punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment if a slave falsely accuses a free man in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning false accusation made by a slave against a free person. Imam Abu ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام states that the punishment is eighty lashes, indicating the seriousness of slander and false accusation in Islamic law.
